item.title: Scientific studies calculate climate change as health danger, while Trump calls it a ‘scam’
item.description: Again and again, research has found increasing disease and deaths in a warming world.

item.title: Federal judge orders Trump administration to keep paying Colorado public health grants
item.description: Colorado and three other states sued Wednesday to prevent the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services from halting $600 million in ongoing public health grants.

item.title: House renames press gallery after Frederick Douglass in bipartisan recognition of Black history
item.description: The event was attended by prominent Black conservative activists, faith leaders and White House officials.

item.title: Puerto Rico governor signs law to recognize fetus as human being as critics warn of consequences
item.description: The amendment was approved Thursday without public hearings and amid concerns from opponents.

item.title: No victims found after shooter kills himself in Evergreen, Jeffco sheriff says
item.description: The Jefferson County Sheriff's Office reported the shooting in the 32000 block of Ellingwood Trail in Evergreen at 5:14 p.m. and said there were "no known victims" as of 5:25 p.m.

item.title: Get the love part right: It’s about knowing each other, sacrifice and sticking around on bad days
item.description: Sometimes, as the songs go, love stinks, love bites and love hurts.

item.title: Windsor’s Reagan Annable claims 4A state diving title
item.description: After being the runner-up in one-meter diving during the Class 4A girls swimming and diving championships each of the past two years, Annable finally claimed the gold medal she had long coveted Thursday afternoon in Thornton.

item.title: Pilgrim’s Pride boosts sales in fourth quarter, 2025 fiscal year
item.description: Greeley-based poultry producer Pilgrim’s Pride Corp. (Nasdaq: PPC) improved its year-over-year sales in both the fourth quarter of 2025 and the full fiscal year, but fell slightly short of Wall Street expectations.

item.title: Michelin Guide expanding to include all of Colorado
item.description: The Michelin Guide, which debuted in Colorado in 2023 and has thus far only featured restaurants in Boulder, Denver, Aspen and Vail, will expand its coverage in future editions to include the whole state.
